title: The Morning Digest: October 10, 2026
dek: Hurricane Isaias made landfall in the western Florida Panhandle Friday night and was post-tropical by Saturday morning after shutting in ~71.5% of Gulf oil output. Friday's session was a round trip: a morning selloff on Trump's Iran comments, then a recovery into the close, WTI Nov26 $91.85 (+$0.36), Brent Dec26 $104.72 (+$0.44). The big new input: a Trump-Putin diesel deal with OFAC General License 135 authorizing Russian diesel imports through April 2027; diesel futures fell 4.6% post-settle. Late Friday the US struck Iranian military targets in retaliation for Thursday's ship drone attacks; a tanker was struck NW of Oman at ~02:00 MDT Saturday. ICE (Oct 9): TMW Nov26 -$24.78, Dec26 -$25.60 still the widest tenor. The SPR exchange award is still pending.
